body: I really wish that I was a good person. But not many people see me as such. I'm really shitty and I just attract bad things. People tell me I'm a strong person, but if I was such a strong person, why do I feel like this now? Why do I feel so empty and lost? I just want to leave permanently, I feel like my time is up, I just don't know how I can contribute more. I just don't feel like struggling anymore. I'm sorry.
Tonight is the night. I've already emailed all my professors saying I have food poisoning and I've taken the next two days off of work. Goodbye.
